objective: Run the first bounded global population-proxy load cell through the formal VM chain and classify it with independent access, route, egress, and ISL-pressure gates before registering a higher load.
context: The traffic source is a checked-in population raster proxy, not measured subscriber traffic.
The load10 pair is a deterministic duplicate integrity check, not a load-response contrast.
The scene decision contract is frozen separately from the simulator configuration and must be hash-bound before authorization.
deliverables: a clean compiled matrix with two identical load10 cells
natural-end, conservation-verified external-witness receipts for each cell
a scene_check report using the full population coverage ledger and the frozen scene decision contract
a finalization artifact hash map that includes the scene decision, coverage audit, and scene-check contract before authorization
one closed classification: ACCESS_LIMITED, ROUTE_LIMITED, NO_ISL_PRESSURE, or ISL_PRESSURE_CANDIDATE
cannot_claim: a global ISL pressure threshold or load-response curve
that load10 is the first pressure point before higher registered loads are checked
real subscriber traffic, universal global service, algorithm superiority, information value, reinforcement-learning value, or a new-algorithm contribution
acceptance: population-gravity formal intent accepts an empty explicit sites list because the raster is the endpoint universe
matrix compile and receipt/authorization gates remain fail-closed
scene-decision.yaml, coverage-audit.json, and scene-check-contract.json are included in the finalization artifact hash map and a tamper check fails before authorization
coverage L1, access L3, route L4, egress L5, and ISL L6 are reported separately
no VM run starts before exact-SHA independent review, accepted finalization, clean-main deployment, and external-witness gates
